messages.subject: Kingsmoor House, Leeds - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to catch up on Friday. As discussed we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the acquisition of Kingsmoor House on Wellington Street in Leeds - a multi-let office block we've agreed heads on at £14.25m. We'll acquire through a new SPV. Helena is running it on our side, Priya on the numbers.

Can you get the engagement letter across and start as soon as Marlowe Greaves send the contract pack?

Marcus

messages.subject: RE: Kingsmoor House, Leeds - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Delighted to help. Engagement letter attached - James Osei will lead day to day with Elena Marchetti supporting, and I'll supervise. Our fee estimate is £34-42k plus VAT and disbursements, and we've flagged SDLT of c. £711k at £14.25m.

Please sign and return and we'll be underway. We've written to Marlowe Greaves to chase the title pack.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
